semantic_review.basis: R03-R16 and R27 define input domain, selection, every validation case, success, renewed editing, Cancel, equal/unequal replacement and all callback boundaries; none is a hidden-only semantic. R04 and R26 now also have independent exact-order and superseded-copy exclusion atoms.
Exact models/signatures and fixed copy are pinned by api-contract.json plus source/api; the caller bridges contain only decoding and real callback forwarding, with no remount or local product state.

Every prose clause and checkpoint sentence has responsibility and source pointer; every runtime obligation, source audit and integration gate has a prose owner; every rule has applicable cells and obligation ownership.

Native runtime rules are labels, selection, enabled state, switch Boolean, conditional presence, native rectangles and dispatch-qualified callback intervals; computed font/padding, leading alignment, same-handler ordering and painted/control composition are explicitly source-only. Final native state is separate from source handler ordering.

Rendered canvas, rendered primary fill, content presence, exact order, superseded-copy exclusion, wrapping and overlap are separate atoms. Primary ROI is x=1%..3%, y=35%..65% under assessed width<=358/height>=48 and source fill-band/corner premises; existing collector and all thresholds/tolerance are unchanged.

R01 assigns two-file declarations to A-file-scope and full production-root byte preservation/change scope to separately pinned initial/final/capture integration gate methods; this authoring self-check does not claim those future gate receipts exist.
Both routes have the same six checkpoint semantics and are inside the public width/text-size domain. Long data changes no public behavior or oracle definition.

scope: Exact prose ownership, typed source pointers, schema, matrix, routes, environments and launch manifests; manual semantic self-review by the design author; no SDK or independent second-person approval.
